findings.title: Save, Load, and Delete commands are discarded
findings.acceptance: UI-driven save, restart, full-state load comparison, delete, and storage verification pass on each supported platform.

findings.title: Native HD bitmap root does not match the asset layout
findings.acceptance: A known HD override renders from the production path and falls back to the original BMP when removed.

findings.title: WASM never prefetches HD override bytes
findings.acceptance: A browser requests, caches, decodes, and renders a known hd/{dll}/{id} resource with verified dimensions.

findings.title: WASM omits troop data prefetch
findings.acceptance: Native and browser troop-class inventories match and emit no fallback diagnostics.

findings.title: Victory modal is unreachable in normal play
findings.acceptance: Every win/loss route reaches the accepted result UI and clean transition sequence.

findings.title: Interactive combat does not establish core combat parity
findings.acceptance: Deterministic fixtures prove accepted mechanics and identical permanent result application in all combat entry paths.

findings.title: Long-running AI simulation exhibits runaway fleet behavior
root_causes: In-transit fleets remain eligible for AI dispatch and replacement orders reset travel progress.
Production creates replacement one-ship fleets at shipyards vacated by in-transit fleets.
Only one opposing fleet pair per system resolves on a five-tick cadence, creating a combat backlog.
findings.acceptance: Multi-seed bounds for fleet count, orders, event volume, targeting, balance, combat spread, and victory timing all pass.

findings.title: Browser media and mods are incomplete
findings.acceptance: Each feature works in browser or is explicitly excluded from the supported browser contract.

findings.title: Release quality gates are not enforced
evidence: GitHub Actions workflow definitions intentionally untracked on 2026-09-08; verification is manual
findings.acceptance: CI enforces the versioned local acceptance commands and retains reproducible artifacts.

findings.title: Bitmap files decode, but display correctness is unproven
evidence: Astra medium browser run R6: Strategy 11016-11027 returned HTTP 200 but rendered character portraits
ghidra/notes/FUN_00405560.c: animated COMMON.DLL resource bases are non-sequential logical controls
Astra medium browser run R8: correct fleet resources and interactions, failed visible blue matte
Astra medium browser run R9: seven representative miniatures passed identity, zero-matte-pixel, aspect-ratio, request, manifest, and interaction checks
findings.acceptance: Every image consumer has resource identity, runtime load, screenshot, interaction, and fallback evidence on each claimed platform.

findings.title: Deterministic replay is not established
evidence: F-011A adds a versioned canonical logical-state fingerprint to native and browser save metadata
two independently seeded initial campaigns now produce identical fingerprints after unordered map and set normalization
Astra medium r3 passed 34 browser save, reload, load, bitmap, network, and error assertions with a matching verified fingerprint
unordered map iteration affects movement and AI tie-breaking
headless and app paths consume random values differently
save state omits RNG, AI runtime, combat cooldown, configuration, and data hashes
remaining: persist RNG and all deterministic continuation state
record and replay versioned command streams
converge headless and interactive tick paths
compare native, WASM, automatic, and tactical checkpoints
findings.acceptance: Repeated native and native-versus-WASM runs produce identical versioned fingerprints from the same seed and command stream, including across save/load.

findings.title: Interactive and headless simulation loops diverge
findings.acceptance: One authoritative simulation entry point produces identical results for the same seed and commands in app, playtest, native, and WASM.

findings.title: The packaged browser artifact omits runtime data
findings.acceptance: A clean unpacked browser artifact boots from its own contents, loads expected data hashes, and passes browser smoke tests.

findings.title: Browser startup, memory, and rendering are not release-scaled
evidence: F-014A now packages 52 game-data entries and 2231 BMPs in one deterministic runtime.orpk request
Astra medium passed both factions with exactly four cold-load requests, zero loose DAT/BMP/manifest requests, and no console, page, loading, bitmap, or WebGL errors
raw bytes and decoded textures are retained without eviction
the Galaxy path can perform two egui passes per frame
sector hull geometry is recomputed each frame
remaining: bounded raw and decoded asset caches
findings.acceptance: Indexed asset packing, lazy decode, bounded LRU caches, one UI pass, cached geometry, and cross-browser tests meet the recorded performance budgets.

findings.title: Browser persistence is not production-safe
evidence: save schema does not preserve all deterministic continuation state
findings.acceptance: Versioned compressed IndexedDB saves round-trip complete state asynchronously, surface quota/corruption errors, and preserve fingerprints.

material_corrections: Load Game from the main menu enters a default Alliance world without slot selection or faction restoration.
Browser audio is wholly unavailable because AudioEngine is excluded on WASM.
Native advisor frames depend on a gitignored reference-art directory and are not guaranteed in release artifacts.
Interactive combat result application omits officer capture and can disagree with core auto-resolution.
Autoresearch parameter tuning should pause until simulation feedback defects and determinism are corrected.

browser_asset_strategy.loading: fetch pack once, lazy-decode requested resources, retain decoded textures in a bounded LRU

security: no hidden GameWorld state in client memory

optimization_roadmap.name: Password-protected Cloudflare release
work: deploy the self-contained browser artifact to Cloudflare Pages
gate every HTML, WASM, DAT, bitmap, save, and multiplayer route with Pages Functions middleware
store SITE_PASSWORD and SESSION_SECRET as encrypted Cloudflare secrets, never in source
